worldFact.fact: About 1,200 people live packed onto Santa Cruz del Islote, a Caribbean island just 200 metres long and 60 metres wide that is reachable only by boat from Tolú. There is no police force; as one resident put it, 'We don't have violence, we don't need police.'

Shocker of a night for Arsenal. So poor in front of goal. Not a fan of Arteta having those words with Dowman as he went off. Hope he watches that again and admits he made a mistake to Max. He really should. A night to forget for the champions. A night to reme
